No. 1909/16 – MONDAY, APRIL 06, 2015
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT, (CHAPTER 460)
AS AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION
(AMENDMENT) ACT, No. 28 OF 1964
Notice under Section 7

I, hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for construction of over fly across the Maho railway line.

Description of the Land acquired: The under mentioned allotments of land situated in Pahala Visideke Korale, of Maho Divisional Secretary’s Division, in the District of Kurunegala, North Western province.
Grama Niladhari’s Division: 156 Munamalegama; Village: Munamalegama; F.V.P. No: 1846; Date of Map: 31.12.2014; No. of Lots: 183.
